description: This file defines an abstract class 'Dimension' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing properties related to worksheet dimensions such as visibility, outline level, collapse state, and formatting index.

classes.name: Dimension
classes.description: Abstract class that encapsulates properties and behaviors common to worksheet dimensions, such as visibility, outline level, collapsed state, and formatting index.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of Dimension, optionally with a format index.

methods.name: getVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the dimension is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the dimension.

methods.name: getOutlineLevel
methods.description: Returns the outline level of the dimension.

methods.name: setOutlineLevel
methods.description: Sets the outline level, must be between 0 and 7; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: getCollapsed
methods.description: Returns whether the dimension is collapsed.

methods.name: setCollapsed
methods.description: Sets the collapsed state of the dimension.

methods.name: getXfIndex
methods.description: Returns the index to cellXf format or null if not set.

methods.name: setXfIndex
methods.description: Sets the index to cellXf format.
